Name: Jasper's children
Author: lemurkat
Description:
This mod turns your children with Jasper into real NPCs.
Your first child will be adventurous and outgoing; the second is sensitive and studious.

[b][u]Features include:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Seasonal[/b] portraits and sprites: One outfit for every season, plus Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve outfits.
[*]Over 100 lines of dialogue per child.
[*][b]Configurable title[/b] (do you want to be "Mommy" or "Papa" or even "Dreadlord"? Whatever you choose, the children will use).
[*][b]Diligent father[/b]: Jasper's schedule means that he will spend Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays taking the children outside. 
[*][b]Schedule Details[/b]
[spoiler]﻿On Mondays, there is a field trip to the Archaeology House (where Jasper reads them a story before taking them to the beach). On Wednesday,  Jasper walks them to school, teaches, and takes them to the forest (if Community Center Reimagined installed) before walking them home in the evening. On Friday, they go home with Vincent and have dinner with Jodi before Jasper picks them up just before 7. (He may still visit the library, the resort, or attend cooking class without them).[/spoiler]﻿[*][b]Field Trips: [/b]
[/list] ﻿Once Jasper has met Professor Snail), he and the kids will visit Ginger Island on the 13th of each season.﻿
﻿If [b]East Scarp[/b] is installed, Jasper and the kids visit his father's memorial on the anniversary (summer 15)
﻿If [b]Stray Catfe[/b] is installed, Jasper and the kids visit the cafe on the 21st of every season.
[list]
[*][b]Events[/b]: These can be triggered once you reach ten hearts with both children. *Most do not show on Event Lookup (See Articles for details)
[/list] There are four seasonally repeatable events with both children (currently only winter and summer are written).
﻿﻿[b]Repeatable Play Events[/b]: some mornings the children will invite you to "play with them" at a set location or time.
﻿﻿You can accept or decline. (Inspired by SuperT's Date Night mod).[list]
[*]The children will attend festivals, including the [b]Fireworks[/b] and [b]Ridgeside[/b]'s festivals.
[*]Additional dialogue if you have Dwarf living with you as a flatmate (using [b]Free Love[/b]).
[*]Compatible with [b]Community Center Reimagined[/b].
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]: Please let me know if you find any issues.
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Reimagined 3[/b].
[*]Compatible with [b]Custom Gift Dialogue[/b]: There are three unique reactions for each child (linked to specific gifts), plus an additional line or two with [b]Trinkets[/b] and [b]Forest Amber[/b].

[/list]
FOR DETAILS ON EVENTS & FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS, PLEASE SEE THE [u]"ARTICLES"[/u] SECTION
[b]
Limitations:[/b]
This mod only works if you're married to Jasper. He won't care if the kids aren't biologically his, but if you divorce him, it will stop working. This isn't so much a limitation as an incentive to not divorce my scruffy geologist.
Whilst I have done my best to make this mod  compatible with Stardew Expanded, please note that making events in Cindersap cross-mod compatible is something of a challenge. As such it is recommended you chop down the tree at Forest 62,37 (or use a terrain reset on the map).
This mod has not been tested with Reimagined, Reimagined2 or Karmylla's maps.

If you've no intention in marrying him, and have just downloaded this mod in either support or to use as a reference for making your own pack, then Thank You. I will have DPs enabled and every DL helps. If you enjoy it, please endorse it.
AND if you have married him, then THANK YOU too, and I hope this pack enriches your experience. I love my scruffy geologist, and I am delighted that other folks feel affection for him too.

[b]TRANSLATIONS:[/b]
Due to the excessive use of tokens in this mod, there are two pages for translation.

If you are a mod-maker and wanting to make your own LittleNPC pack, you are welcome to use mine for reference purposes, with the following caveats:
- I do not grant permission to copy my portraits, sprites, dialogue or schedules.
- I do not grant permission to copy the events, even if you intend to rewrite the dialogue.
- Please mention me in your credits.

[b]SPECIAL THANKS TO:[/b]
[list]
[*]Atravita for helping with the code (specifically i18n and tokens)
[*]Avis for helping with the portraits (especially the fairy Spirit's Eve costume and the boy's hair).
[*]Poltergeister for advising on portraits.
[*]Gnadi for SVE testing and compatibility adjustment.
[*]Narada & Gnadi for alpha testing (and finding the limitations of the tokens).
[*]Also, huge thanks to Candidus for keeping Child to NPC alive and for creating the Little NPCs framework. Without you, these kids wouldn't exist.
[*]SuperT for Date Night, the format of which proved inspiration for the randomized "play" events
[*]and the East Scarp and Krobus Discords for general support, advice and being there!
[/list][b]
[/b]

Downloads.Description:
Jasper's children: A pack for Little NPCs.
Open the config file to set your own Title (Default is Farmer as name does not work).
Seems to work in 1.6. Pls report any bugs with content. Children void-walking in the bus-stop is a known Little NPCs bug.
